sentence: This project studies how pro-obesity high fat diets affect the spread of colorectal cancer, called metastasis.
This project studies how lysosomal cholesterol transport changes ion channels and shapes neuronal function.
This project tries to find out which cells and signals make prostate cancer that spread to bone resist immunotherapy.
This project works to understand the risk factors, causes and treatment of problem alcohol use, using genetics, behavior and neurobiology.
This project studies symptoms, management and genes in Black and White people with Parkinson disease to understand racial disparities.
This project studies how spotted fever group rickettsiae interact with macrophages and avoid the immune response, including the role of mitochondria.
This project builds real-time methods to model neural manifolds shaped by external stimuli and to disturb neural dynamics with stimulation.
This project tests whether immune cell activation in the heart raises the risk of lethal arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death in people with HIV.
This project develops a single shot measles vectored rabies vaccine for children.
This project builds a low-cost technology to preserve fungal RNA from vaginal swabs and find gene-expression signatures that separate harmless yeast colonization from disease.
This project builds a platform that uses sound to move and trap small particles and cells for separation, isolation and enrichment.
This project tries to find out if Borrelia burgdorferi, immune response and genetics explain Lyme disease symptoms that last after antibiotic treatment.
This project studies how to make salivary gland progenitor cells and organoids from human pluripotent stem cells.
This project develops measures of biological aging to study how sex differences in aging health outcomes arise.
This project develops 3D highly multiplexed imaging of tissues and tumors and uses machine learning to study the cancer ecosystem at a single-cell level.
This project builds a tool that turns off specific activities of mobile genetic elements to find out how they affect brain function.
This project builds a human 3D neuromuscular model to study how aging harms muscle stem cell function, neuromuscular junctions and contractile strength.
This project studies the cell biology of specific neural cells and how Alzheimer's disease disrupts them.
This project builds assays and screening methods to test drug targets for Alzheimer's disease beyond amyloid beta.
This project studies cancer risk, early detection, prevention and treatment response, with a focus on liver, lung, breast and kidney cancer.
